project_type: Next.js 16.x App Router full-stack app, TypeScript strict, Prisma 7 + SQLite (dev), NextAuth.js v5 beta, Tailwind CSS v4, Vitest
build_system: Next.js with Turbopack for dev, standard next build for prod. Prisma 7 uses driver adapters (@prisma/adapter-better-sqlite3). Generated client is in src/generated/prisma/ (run `npx prisma generate` after any schema change). bcryptjs (not bcrypt) used for password hashing.
test_framework: Vitest + @testing-library/react + jsdom. Tests live in src/app/api/__tests__/ and src/lib/__tests__/. Config in vitest.config.ts.
verification_instructions: After each feature: (1) `npm run typecheck` — must exit 0. (2) `npm run build` — must exit 0. (3) `npm run lint` — must exit 0 or document any new warnings. After schema changes: `npx prisma migrate dev --name <name>` then `npx prisma generate`. Final check: `npm run test`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ — regenerated by `npx prisma generate`. Never hand-edit. prisma/migrations/ — committed. uploads/ — runtime artifacts, gitignored.
environment_constraints: Next.js 16.x renamed export const dynamic to export const instant (false = blocking, true = static). The sign-in page uses `await connection()` which triggers the prerender error — must be removed. Admin routes use `export const instant = false` correctly. Do NOT use CSS variable arbitrary values like [--color-brand] in Tailwind — use hex literals.
contribution_requirements: All Tailwind classes use hex values (not CSS variable arbitrary values). Enterprise navy #1e3a5f primary. All inputs need accessible labels. Use existing UI components: Button, Input, Select, DataTable, Dialog, Badge, PageHeader, Card, Toast, Textarea. No new dependencies unless absolutely unavoidable.
key_patterns: API routes: import requireAdmin from @/lib/auth-utils, call writeAuditEvent from @/lib/audit after mutations, return apiSuccess/apiError from @/lib/api-response. Zod schemas in src/lib/schemas/. Server components use `export const instant = false` for dynamic pages. Client components are 'use client' and use fetch() directly. OrgUnitsManager.tsx is the pattern to follow for inline CRUD with add/edit/delete. IssuanceActions.tsx is the pattern for action dialogs.
